content.short: PocketFi is a DeFi aggregator and bridge on TON that simplifies cross-chain swaps and asset management.
content.description: PocketFi is a powerful DeFi aggregator and cross-chain bridging solution operating within the Telegram ecosystem. It provides users with a streamlined interface to swap assets between TON and other major blockchains like Solana and Ethereum. By aggregating liquidity from various sources, PocketFi ensures that users get optimal rates with minimal friction. Its focus on accessibility and integration with Telegram's social features makes it an essential tool for users looking to manage a multi-chain portfolio from a single, secure bot.
content.meta: Swap across chains seamlessly with PocketFi on TON. DeFi aggregation and bridging on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
